flow.profile.v1.Profile.description:
Profile is the public face of a business member inside Flow: identity plus
the projects they chose to make discoverable. It backs the in-app profile
page opened from avatars, comment authors and member pickers.

bio.description: bio is what the person says about themselves. Empty if unset.

email.description:
email is the account email. Business members already share a roster;
this echoes it for contact actions.

initials.description: initials are two-letter uppercase initials derived from name.

public_projects.description:
public_projects lists the subject's PUBLIC projects - metadata only.
Private projects never appear here regardless of caller; opening any of
them still requires membership or a bypass role.

role_title.description: role_title is the person's business role or job title, when set.

flow.profile.v1.ProfileProject.description:
ProfileProject is the metadata card for one public project. Deliberately
carries no task-level fields: public means "discoverable", not "openable".

color.description: color is the project color hex.

completed_count.description: completed_count is the done task count. Display projection.

description.description: description is the short project description.

name.description: name is the project display name.

status.description: status is the current lifecycle state.

task_count.description: task_count is the total task count. Display projection.
